name: soa-prod
description: Son of Anton — desktop terminal + mobile companion, shipped as one app.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop/src install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.install:linux: npm install && npm --prefix desktop run install-linux
scripts.install:windows: npm install && npm --prefix desktop run install-windows
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:mobile && npm --prefix desktop run prebuild-darwin && npm --prefix desktop run build-darwin && npm --prefix desktop run postbuild-darwin
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:mobile && npm --prefix desktop run prebuild-linux && npm --prefix desktop run build-linux && npm --prefix desktop run postbuild-linux
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:mobile && npm --prefix desktop run prebuild-windows && npm --prefix desktop run build-windows && npm --prefix desktop run postbuild-windows
